as_told.title: Alien seen working alongside human staff at a facility

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that during a classified mission at a military facility he walked past a row of people working and saw among them an insect-like being, what he calls an insectoid. He says he looked away at once and kept walking, and admits it could have been a soldier in some kind of alien headgear. If it was what he thought, it would mean non-humans working alongside the military.
